defect: Running storage-formal.mjs concurrently with the internally runtime/non-runtime sharded formal.mjs can make a valid TLC mutation witness fail as parser/classpath infrastructure rather than semantics.

reproduction.diagnostic: TLC/SANY could not resolve standard module Sequences imported by FiniteSets during the overlapping third TLC family.

control: The same internally two-sharded formal runner passed 6/6 focused rounds when storage-formal was not concurrent, each in approximately 15.4-16.8 seconds.
requiredFix: Never co-schedule storage-formal with the internally sharded formal runner; storage may overlap only non-TLC packed-consumer work, and formal starts after that batch completes.

resolution.workspaceIsolationResult: Private generated-module/metadir workspaces eliminate same-name cross-invocation file collisions and passed direct concurrent runtime-formal controls.

crossFamilyResult.diagnostic: During storage-formal + internally sharded formal overlap, SANY failed to resolve standard module Sequences imported by FiniteSets while checking WorkOnceExternalInvariantMutationBatch.
crossFamilyResult.requiredRule: Keep storage-formal serialized from formal.mjs even though each runner also uses a private TLC workspace.
